import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Prepare data for visualization
# Map numerical values to more descriptive strings for clarity in the plot
df['Survival Status'] = df['survived'].map({0: 'Died', 1: 'Survived'})
df['Passenger Class'] = df['pclass'].map({1: '1st Class', 2: '2nd Class', 3: '3rd Class'})

# Set the aesthetic style of the plots
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid", font_scale=1.1)

# Create a figure and a set of subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(16, 7), gridspec_kw={'width_ratios': [3, 1]})
fig.suptitle('Survival on the Titanic: A Tale of Class and Demographics', fontsize=20, fontweight='bold')

# --- Plot 1: Survival Rate by Class and Sex ---
ax1 = axes[0]
sns.barplot(
    data=df,
    x='Passenger Class',
    y='survived',
    hue='sex',
    ax=ax1,
    palette={'male': '#5499c7', 'female': '#f1948a'},
    estimator=np.mean,
    errorbar=None
)
ax1.set_title('Survival Rate by Passenger Class and Sex', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=12)
ax1.set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=12)
ax1.set_yticklabels(['{:.0%}'.format(x) for x in ax1.get_yticks()])
ax1.legend(title='Sex')

# Add annotations to the bars
for p in ax1.patches:
    ax1.annotate(
        f'{p.get_height():.0%}',
        (p.get_x() + p.get_width() / 2., p.get_height()),
        ha='center',
        va='center',
        fontsize=11,
        color='black',
        xytext=(0, 5),
        textcoords='offset points'
    )

# --- Plot 2: Age Distribution of Survivors vs. Non-Survivors ---
ax2 = axes[1]
sns.kdeplot(
    data=df,
    x='age',
    hue='Survival Status',
    ax=ax2,
    fill=True,
    common_norm=False,
    palette={'Died': '#d9534f', 'Survived': '#5cb85c'},
    alpha=0.6,
    linewidth=1.5
)
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution by Survival Status', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=12)
ax2.set_ylabel('Density', fontsize=12)
ax2.legend(title='Status')

# Improve layout
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0.03, 1, 0.95])

# Save the final figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
